design_basis: Latest approved generated streetscape concept; not a surveyed historic reconstruction
scope: Independent 621 facade and shallow structural returns; no adjacent storefronts, full building body, roof, or interior fit-out

authoring_policy.full_blocks: Wall cores, piers, continuous masonry bands and floor strips
authoring_policy.microblocks: Fractional openings, reveals, mouldings, pediments, awning, narrow frames and ornaments
authoring_policy.promotion: Homogeneous registered Minecraft cubes and supported half cubes become vanilla blocks/slabs. RGB materials remain Astra hosts.

status: REJECTED_AS_REDFIELD_REFERENCE: generated concept architecture does not reproduce verified Redfield photographs
